description_en: Updates the SLA timeout alert for a task flow
description_zh: 调用此API可以更新任务流SLA超时提醒
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise update-sla-rules --dag-id 110000 --tid 3000 --sla-rule-list Type=0 NodeId=0 IntervalMinutes=1080 DagId=15000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateSLARules

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task flow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 任务流ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_id

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.
You can view the tenant ID by hovering over the profile icon in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
